output.one_liner: Team chat and communication software for businesses with built-in messaging, channels, bots, and AI-powered collaboration features.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 with Bearer token authentication. Access tokens expire after 1 hour and can be refreshed using refresh tokens. Multiple client types supported (server-based, client-based, mobile-based, non-browser, self-client).

evidence.snippet: Zoho Cliq API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication. OAuth 2.0 is an industry-standard protocol specification
Zoho's OAuth implementation uses the Bearer authentication scheme; hence, when making API calls, the access token must be passed
Access tokens are valid for 1 hour. Use the stored refresh token to generate a new access token.
